hubs.title: Pigments that changed painting
hubs.dek: Every so often a new material arrives and painters' skies, skins or shadows change. These are the colors behind those moments.
hubs.intro:
A pigment is a physical thing: ground rock, burnt bone, a coal-tar dye. When a new one becomes cheap enough, you can often see the date in the paintings.

These collections are lists drawn from our color graph, and each color opens its own page.

hubs.title: Purples, mauves and lilacs
hubs.dek: Soft purples that people treat as synonyms.

blue.title: Blue
blue.dek: Several different blues are called this, depending on who is asking.
